name: empty-state
summary: Explains an empty result and offers an optional real navigation link as a next step.

agent.useWhen: A collection or first-use area has no content and one next step is useful.
agent.avoidWhen: Content is loading, failed, forbidden, or completed successfully.

invariants: Title and body are required nonblank plain text; values are HTML-escaped and never interpreted as markup or templates.
Alignment is start or center and defaults to start. Heading level is h2, h3, or h4 and defaults to h2.
actionHref and actionLabel are optional but must be supplied together; the destination must be a safe HTTP(S) or relative URL and the action is a native navigation link.
The section contains its configurable semantic heading, description, and optional link in source order; no command, fake button, script, or browser-local state is created.
The static region has no live-announcement semantics; the consuming page owns any dynamic replacement lifecycle.
The adapter fragment contains exactly one [[empty-state]] slot, expanded in one pass after validation.
